name: AXION
tagline: From Vision to Production, in Weeks Not Months
about: AXION is an AI-accelerated software development company that pairs AI-powered workflows with senior enterprise engineers to ship production-ready applications in weeks, not months. They serve startups and enterprises across regulated industries including healthcare, insurance, finance, and government. Every product is professionally architected, security-hardened, and cloud-deployed on Azure or AWS.
audience: Founders, CTOs, and product leaders at startups and enterprises in regulated, high-stakes industries (healthcare, insurance, finance, manufacturing, government) who need fast, secure, production-ready software without the traditional 4–12 month delivery timelines
avoid: Positioning AI as a gimmick or replacement for engineers — it amplifies them
